app.title: Admin
inactive.title: Inactive account
inactive.text: The account {{email}} does not have access to the admin yet. Ask an administrator to activate it.
login.subtitle: Sign in to add and edit events.
login.resetSent: If this address has an account, you will receive an email with a link to a new password in a few minutes.
login.resetNeedsEmail: Type your email address first, then press “Forgot password”.
login.inviteOnly: Accounts are created only by invitation from an administrator.
login.errors.notConfirmed: The email address has not been confirmed yet.
login.errors.google: Google sign-in is not enabled yet.
login.errors.noAccess: This account has no access. Accounts are created only by invitation.
login.errors.generic: We could not sign you in. Please try again.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, address or place
list.loadError: The events could not be loaded.
list.empty: You have not added any events yet.
list.confirmText: “{{title}}” will disappear from the site. This cannot be undone.
list.deleteError: The event could not be deleted.
form.notFound: The event was not found or you do not have access to it.
form.notYours: This event was added by someone else. Only its author or an administrator can change it.
form.textsHint: Romanian is required. In the other languages, anything missing is shown in Romanian.
form.summaryHint: 1–2 sentences, shown on the event card.
form.contentHint: Programme, prices, details. Line breaks are kept.
form.endHint: For a single evening it can be the next day (e.g. 02:00).
form.externalUrlHint: Optional: the event on Facebook or the registration form.
form.locationHint: As shown on the site, e.g.: Feeling Dance Studio, Strada Vasile Alecsandri 12, Oradea.
form.mapHint: Optionally pick the exact place on the map: on the site, the location button opens Google Maps right there.
form.photoResized: The photo is resized automatically before upload.
form.photoDefault: Without its own photo, the site shows the default photo (the faded one above). On a phone you can also take a photo directly.
form.publishedHint: The event appears on the site right after saving.
form.draftHint: Only you (and the administrators) can see a draft; it does not appear on the site.
form.previewTitle: How it looks on the site
form.toast.photoFailed: The photo could not be uploaded. Try another one (JPG, PNG or WebP).
form.toast.notAllowed: You are not allowed to change this event.
form.toast.saveFailed: The event could not be saved. Check the details and try again.
form.toast.invalid: Some fields need to be corrected.
form.toast.draftRestored: We restored the unsaved texts from last time.
errors.startRequired: Choose the start date and time.
errors.endRequired: Choose the end date and time.
errors.slugFormat: Only lowercase letters without accents, digits and hyphens (e.g. milonga-de-toamna).
errors.slugTaken: This address is already used by another event. Choose another one.
errors.urlFormat: The link must start with https://
errors.summaryNeedsRo: Fill in the Romanian short description too.
errors.contentNeedsRo: Fill in the Romanian full description too.
errors.endBeforeStart: The end cannot be before the start.
prefill.label: Fill in from a link (optional)
prefill.hint: Paste the link of the event page (e.g. the Facebook event) and the title, description and photo are taken from it. You choose the date, time and type.
prefill.filled: Filled in: {{fields}}. Check the texts, then choose the type, date and time.
prefill.nothingChanged: The fields were already filled in; nothing was changed.
prefill.noPreview: The page has no preview information (e.g. a private Facebook event or one that needs a login). Fill in by hand.
prefill.photoFailed: The photo from the page could not be taken; you can choose one by hand.
prefill.field.title: the title
prefill.errors.badUrl: The link does not look valid. Copy the full address, starting with https://
prefill.errors.unreadable: The page could not be read. Check the link or fill in by hand.
prefill.errors.gateway: Supabase refused the request: turn off “Verify JWT” for the “link-preview” function.
prefill.errors.unreachable: The “link-preview” function does not answer. Check that it is deployed in Supabase (README, section 9).
prefill.errors.generic: The details could not be taken from the link. Fill in by hand.
map.search: Search the address on the map
map.searchFailed: The search did not work right now. You can place the point directly with a click on the map.
map.notFound: Address not found. Try just the street and the city, or place the point with a click on the map.
map.label: Map: click to place the event location
map.pointChosen: Chosen point: {{lat}}, {{lng}} (you can drag it on the map)
map.pointHint: Search the address or click on the map to set the exact place.
users.title: Users
users.intro: Who can use the admin. An inactive account can no longer add or change anything; its events stay on the site.
users.loadError: The list could not be loaded.
users.modeInviteHint: They get a link and choose their own password.
users.modePasswordHint: You choose the password and tell it to the person.
users.name: Name
users.roleEditorHint: Adds and edits only their own events.
users.roleAdminHint: Can do everything, including adding and deactivating users.
users.toast.created: The account {{email}} was created. Tell the person the chosen password.
users.toast.existing: {{email}} already had an account: it is now active.
users.toast.lastAdmin: There must be at least one active administrator.
users.toast.changeFailed: The change could not be saved.
users.errors.weakPassword: The password must have at least 8 characters.
users.errors.badEmail: The email address does not look right.
users.errors.notAdmin: Only an administrator can add accounts.
users.errors.gateway: Supabase refused the request: turn off “Verify JWT” for the “invite-user” function (Edge Functions → invite-user → Settings), then try again. The function itself checks that you are an administrator.
users.errors.unreachable: The invitation function does not answer. Check that “invite-user” is deployed in Supabase (README, section 8).
users.errors.rateLimit: Supabase has already sent too many emails in the last hour. Try later or create the account with a password.
users.errors.emailFailed: The invitation could not be emailed. Check the email settings in Supabase or create the account with a password.
users.errors.generic: The account could not be created. Please try again.
password.expired: The link in the email has expired or was already used.
password.openLink: To set the password, open the link you received by email.
password.askAgain: Ask an administrator for a new invitation or use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
password.title: Set the password
password.forAccount: For the account {{email}}. You will use it to sign in to the admin from now on.
password.tooShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
password.sameAsOld: Choose a password different from the old one.
password.failed: The password could not be saved. Please try again.
account.title: My account
account.nameHint: Shown on the site with the events you added (“Added by …”). If you leave it empty, nothing is shown.
account.nameFailed: The name could not be saved. Please try again.
